name: rng
algorithm: n rounds of the standard seeded generator from the seed in the arguments: total +%= one 64-bit draw, then total +%= one uniform draw below 1000 (README.md).

skip.c: no seeded generator in the C standard library beyond rand(), whose algorithm is unspecified
skip.rust: no generator in Rust's standard library (rand is a crate)
skip.zig: std.Random.Xoshiro256 is xoshiro256++, not xoshiro256**, so no checksum can agree (request R-6: per-column checksums)
skip.go: math/rand/v2 has PCG and ChaCha8, not xoshiro256**, so no checksum can agree (request R-6)
skip.mk-wrap: the checksum already uses the wrapping operators; there is no checked arithmetic to remove

notes: Checksums from a Go model of xoshiro256** seeded through SplitMix64 and Lemire's method (std/std-missing_rng_test.go's model); the Mk build printed both on the owner's machine, 2026-11-07.
